newsitem.title: USA: Nabors sees FY1997 operating income growth.
newsitem.headline: Nabors sees FY1997 operating income growth.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc said on Thursday that it expects growth in operating income and cash flow for the year ending September 1997, based upon investments in rig capacity and modest improvement in capacity use and pricing.
Net income growth will not be as large, due to an increase in the deferred, non-cash, component of the company's effective tax rate, Nabors Industries said.

Nabors, which reported higher fourth quarter profits and sales for the year ended September 30, 1996, said its North American operations showed improved results from higher activity levels, higher day rates, higher utilization and two new Gulf of Mexico platform rigs.
